### Available micronutrients

```{r}
#| label: fig-micronutrient-pca
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

tar_read(micronutrient_pca_plot)
```

###  Data transformation

```{r}
#| label: fig-transformation
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

#| fig-height: 11

Right: standardized values on a shared axis, in the same colour."
